notes: Pass 1, author (content-skill): note, items and sources written from the cited pages, all accessed 2026-10-30; every claim is quoted in quoteOrLocator.

Pass 2, three checkers. Language: romanization of every item and token is the F-CNT-002 converter's output (checked by the build); polite 해요 register in the ko text; Pre-A1 English. Culture and facts: each claim matched to an allowlisted source (§6.6) with the §5.1 conventions. Both dates from the KASI table. No claim about weather is made; the scarf and gloves line is a friendly suggestion, not a fact. Learning design: 5 items, at most 8 new (lesson-new-load), no two items of the drop said alike (dictation-unambiguous), no %, score, age word, speaking line or emoji (review-copy).

Pass 3, reviser and third pass: fixes of pass 2 applied (wording kept plain, every holiday and term date re-read against the KASI table), es and ko overlays re-read against the English; no copy claims native-speaker or expert review.
